segments.tr: تمت زيادة ارتفاع سياج سبتة، وتعزيزه، وتزويده بأجهزة استشعار، وتجريده من الأسلاك الشائكة وإعادة تجهيزه مجدداً عبر عقدين من الحكومات الإسبانية المتعاقبة.

segments.src: It works reasonably well at what it was designed to do.
segments.tr: وهو يعمل بشكل جيد معقول في الغرض الذي صُمم لأجله.

segments.src: What it was never designed to do is close the water.
segments.tr: ما لم يتم تصميمه لأجله قط هو إغلاق المياه.

segments.src: At Tarajal, the border meets the Mediterranean.
segments.tr: في تاراخال (Tarajal)، تلتقي الحدود بالبحر الأبيض المتوسط.

segments.src: The fence ends, and beyond it there is a short stretch of shallow sea that can be swum or waded around at low tide.
segments.tr: ينتهي السياج، وخلفه يمتد شريط قصير من البحر الضحل الذي يمكن السباحة فيه أو خوضه عند الجزر.

segments.src: Historically this was a marginal route.
segments.tr: تاريخياً، كان هذا مساراً هامشياً.

segments.src: In May 2021, when roughly 8,000 people entered Ceuta over about two days after Moroccan border officials stood down, it became the primary one — thousands simply walked and swam around the end of the barrier in full view of cameras.
segments.tr: في مايو 2021، عندما دخل ما يقرب من 8,000 شخص إلى سبتة في غضون يومين تقريباً بعد انسحاب حرس الحدود المغاربة، أصبح هذا المسار هو المسار الرئيسي — حيث مشى وسَبَحَ الآلاف ببساطة حول نهاية الحاجز أمام عدسات الكاميرات.

segments.src: Spain drew the obvious conclusion and began extending a breakwater into the sea to physically close that gap.
segments.tr: استنتجت إسبانيا النتيجة البادية للعيان وبدأت في تمديد كاسر أمواج في البحر لإغلاق تلك الفجوة ماديًا.

segments.src: The current push is an acceleration of that project, not a new idea.
segments.tr: والدفعة الحالية هي تسريع لذلك المشروع وليست فكرة جديدة.

segments.src: Whether it changes the underlying dynamic is a separate question.
segments.tr: أما إذا كانت ستغير الديناميكية الأساسية فهذه مسألة أخرى.

segments.src: A sea barrier converts an easy crossing into a harder one; it does not reduce the number of people who want to cross, and it introduces its own risks in open water — which is the most plausible context for a death toll of this size.
segments.tr: الحاجز البحري يحول العبور السهل إلى عبور أكثر صعوبة؛ وهو لا يقلل من عدد الأشخاص الذين يرغبون في العبور، ويخلق مخاطره الخاصة في المياه المفتوحة — وهو السياق الأكثر ترجيحاً لعدد وفيات بهذا الحجم.

segments.src: ## The part everyone understands and no one states
segments.tr: ## الجزء الذي يفهمه الجميع ولا يصرح به أحد

segments.src: Ceuta's border does not fail at random.
segments.tr: حدود سبتة لا تفشل بشكل عشوائي.

segments.src: It fails when Moroccan enforcement on the other side changes.
segments.tr: إنها تفشل عندما تتغير إجراءات الإنفاذ المغربية على الجانب الآخر.

segments.src: In 2021, Spanish officials were unusually direct in linking that month's surge to a diplomatic rupture over Western Sahara, after Spain admitted the leader of the Polisario Front for medical treatment.
segments.tr: في عام 2021، كان المسؤولون الإسبان صريحين بشكل غير معتاد في ربط تدفق ذلك الشهر بقطيعة دبلوماسية بشأن الصحراء الغربية، بعد أن استقبلت إسبانيا زعيم جبهة البوليساريو لتلقي العلاج الطبي.

segments.src: The border pressure eased once the political dispute was addressed.
segments.tr: وانخفض الضغط على الحدود بمجرد معالجة النزاع السياسي.

segments.src: Spain subsequently shifted its formal position on Western Sahara in 2022, and relations were repaired.
segments.tr: وفي وقت لاحق غيرت إسبانيا موقفها الرسمي من الصحراء الغربية في عام 2022، وأُصلحت العلاقات.

segments.src: That episode established a pattern that European analysts now treat as a permanent feature of the file: enforcement cooperation at the enclaves is a diplomatic variable, not a fixed condition.
segments.tr: رسخت تلك الواقعة نمطاً يعامله المحللون الأوروبيون الآن كعنصر دائم في هذا الملف: التعاون في إنفاذ القانون عند الجيوب هو متغير دبلوماسي، وليس شرطاً ثابتاً.

segments.src: The same dynamic has appeared on other EU frontiers, notably at the Belarus–Poland and Belarus–Lithuania borders.
segments.tr: وظهَرَت الديناميكية نفسها على حدود أخرى للاتحاد الأوروبي، ولا سيما على الحدود بين بيلاروسيا وبولندا وبين بيلاروسيا وليتوانيا.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: من المهم التزام الحذر هنا.

segments.src: Attributing intent to any government on the basis of a border event in progress is exactly the sort of claim that tends not to survive contact with the record.
segments.tr: إن نسبة النوايا إلى أي حكومة بناءً على حدث حدودي مستمر هي بالضبط نوع الادعاءات التي لا تصمد عادةً أمام التوثيق والوقائع.

segments.src: What can be said without speculation is narrower and more useful: Europe has built a migration system whose functioning depends on the continued cooperation of non-member states, and it has not built a version of that system that works when the cooperation stops.
segments.tr: ما يمكن قوله دون تكهن هو أكثر ضيقاً وأكثر فائدة: لقد بنى الاتحاد الأوروبي نظام هجرة يعتمد أداؤه الوظيفي على التعاون المستمر من دول غير أعضاء، ولم يبنِ نسخة من ذلك النظام تعمل عندما يتوقف هذا التعاون.

segments.src: ## What EU law now allows — and what it doesn't
segments.tr: ## ما يسمح به قانون الاتحاد الأوروبي الآن — وما لا يسمح به

segments.src: The timing matters.
segments.tr: التوقيت مهم.

segments.src: Member states are in the middle of phasing in the EU's Pact on Migration and Asylum, the package agreed in 2024 after nearly a decade of deadlock.
segments.tr: تخوض الدول الأعضاء مرحلة التطبيق التدريجي لميثاق الاتحاد الأوروبي بشأن الهجرة واللجوء، وهو الميثاق المتفق عليه في عام 2024 بعد نحو عقد من الجمود.

segments.src: Its core provisions include mandatory border screening, accelerated procedures at external frontiers, and a solidarity mechanism under which states can accept relocations or pay in instead.
segments.tr: وتشمل أحكامه الأساسية الفحص إلزامي عند الحدود، والإجراءات المسرّعة عند الحدود الخارجية، وآلية تضامن يمكن للدول بموجبها قبول إعادة التوطين أو الدفع بدلاً من ذلك.

segments.src: The Pact also includes something built precisely for a scenario like this: rules covering situations where a third country is judged to be using migration as leverage.
segments.tr: ويتضمن الميثاق أيضاً شيئاً صُمم خصيصاً لسيناريو مثل هذا: قواعد تغطي الحالات التي يُحكم فيها بأن دولة ثالثة تستخدم الهجرة كأداة للضغط.

segments.src: In those cases, a member state can seek authorization to extend registration deadlines, apply border procedures more broadly, and access emergency support.
segments.tr: في تلك الحالات، يمكن للدولة العضو طلب الإذن لتمديد المهل الزمنية للتسجيل، وتطبيق إجراءات الحدود على نطاق أوسع، والحصول على دعم الطوارئ.

segments.src: The catch is that these are procedural tools.
segments.tr: المشكلة الكامنة هي أن هذه أدوات إجرائية.

segments.src: They give a government legal room to process arrivals more slowly and with fewer obligations.
segments.tr: فهي تعطي الحكومة مساحة قانونية لمعالجة طلبات الواصلين بشكل أبطأ وبأقل قدر من الالتزامات.

segments.src: They do not create physical space in a seven-square-mile city, and they do not resolve the question of where people go afterward.
segments.tr: لكنها لا تخلق مساحة مادية في مدينة تبلغ مساحتها سبعة أميال مربعة، ولا تحل مسألة إلى أين يذهب الأشخاص بعد ذلك.

segments.src: Spain also retains an older instrument: a 1992 readmission agreement with Morocco allowing the return of people who entered irregularly, which it used extensively in 2021.
segments.tr: كما تحتفظ إسبانيا بأداة أقدم: اتفاقية إعادة القبول لعام 1992 مع المغرب والتي تسمح بترحيل الأشخاص الذين دخلوا بشكل غير نظامي، والتي استخدمتها بكثرة في عام 2021.

segments.src: And Spanish courts, along with the European Court of Human Rights in its 2020 Grand Chamber ruling on the enclaves, have permitted rapid returns at the border under specific conditions.
segments.tr: وسمحت المحاكم الإسبانية، إلى جانب المحكمة الأوروبية لحقوق الإنسان في حكمها الصادر عام 2020 عن الغرفة الكبرى بشأن الجيوب، بترحيل سريع عند الحدود وفق شروط محددة.

segments.src: Those conditions are contested by rights organizations, and their application at a scale like this would be litigated for years.
segments.tr: تلك الشروط تتنازعها منظمات حقوق الإنسان، وتطبيقها على نطاق مثل هذا يتطلب التقاضي لسنوات طويلة.

segments.src: ## The minors question
segments.tr: ## مسألة القصر

segments.src: One detail from 2021 turned out to be more consequential than the headline number.
segments.tr: تبين أن تفصيلاً واحداً من عام 2021 كان أكثر أهمية وتأثيراً من الرقم الرئيسي المعلن.

segments.src: Of the roughly 8,000 people who entered, an estimated 1,500 were unaccompanied minors — and minors cannot be summarily returned.
segments.tr: من بين ما يقرب من 8,000 شخص دخلوا، كان هناك نحو 1,500 من القصر غير المرفوقين — والقصر لا يمكن ترحيلهم إجرائياً باختصار.

segments.src: They enter a protection system with legal obligations attached.
segments.tr: يدخل هؤلاء نظام حماية تترافق معه التزامات قانونية.

segments.src: That single category dominated Spanish domestic politics for the next four years.
segments.tr: تلك الفئة المفرة هيمنت على السياسة الداخلية الإسبانية للسنوات الأربع التالية.

segments.src: It produced a prolonged standoff between the central government and regional administrations over who was responsible for housing and schooling them, and eventually a mandatory distribution mechanism to move minors out of the enclaves and the Canary Islands to other regions.
segments.tr: وأنتجت مواجهة طال أمدها بين الحكومة المركزية والإدارات الإقليمية حول من يتولى مسؤولية إيوائهم وتعليمهم، وفي النهاية آلية توزيع إلزامية لنقل القصر خارج الجيوب وجزر الكناري إلى مناطق أخرى.

segments.src: If the proportion holds anywhere near constant at the reported scale, this becomes the defining aspect of the aftermath.
segments.tr: إذا ظلت النسبة ثابتة تقريباً عند المقياس المعلن، فإن هذا يصبح الجانب المحدد للتبعات.

segments.src: It is also the aspect least amenable to barriers, agreements, or emergency regulations — the obligations are individual, they attach immediately, and they last for years.
segments.tr: وهو أيضاً الجانب الأقل قابلية للحل عبر الحواجز أو الاتفاقيات أو لوائح الطوارئ — فالالتزامات فردية، وتترتب فوراً، وتستمر لسنوات.

segments.src: ## Why this is a stress test, not an anomaly
segments.tr: ## لماذا يُعد هذا اختبار إجهاد وليس حالة شاذة

segments.src: There is a comfortable reading available: Ceuta is a geographic oddity, a colonial-era remnant that generates problems no other European border has.
segments.tr: هناك قراءة مريحة متاحة: سبتة حالة جغرافية غريبة، وإرث من العصر الاستعماري يولد مشاكل لا تواجهها أي حدود أوروبية أخرى.

segments.src: That reading is half right and dangerously incomplete.
segments.tr: تلك القراءة صحيحة جزئياً وغير مكتملة بشكل خطير.

segments.src: What makes Ceuta instructive is not that it is unusual but that it is small enough to fail visibly and fast.
segments.tr: ما يجعل سبتة كاشفة ليس كونها غير معتادة بل كونها صغيرة بما يكفي لتفشل بشكل مرئي وسريع.

segments.src: The same dependencies exist along the Libyan and Tunisian routes to Italy, the Turkish route to Greece, and the West African route to the Canaries.
segments.tr: نفس التبعيات موجودة على طول المسارات الليبية والتونسية إلى إيطاليا، والمسار التركي إلى اليونان، ومسار غرب إفريقيا إلى جزر الكناري.

segments.src: The difference is that those systems degrade over months, which allows them to be managed as a political process.
segments.tr: الفرق هو أن تلك الأنظمة تتدهور على مدى أشهر، مما يسمح بإدارتها كعملية سياسية.

segments.src: Ceuta degrades over hours, which does not.
segments.tr: بينما تتدهور سبتة في ظرف ساعات، وهو ما لا يتيح ذلك.

segments.src: A policy framework that produces workable outcomes at the pace of a European Council meeting, and collapses at the pace of a weekend, has a specific and identifiable weakness.
segments.tr: إن إطار السياسات الذي ينتج نتائج قابلة للتطبيق بوتيرة اجتماع المجلس الأوروبي، وينهار بوتيرة عطلة نهاية أسبوع، يحتوي على نقطة ضعف المحددة والواضحة.

segments.src: Nine square miles just demonstrated it in public.
segments.tr: تسعة أميال مربعة أثبتت ذلك للتو أمام العلن.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: Three indicators will say more than any communiqué:
segments.tr: ثلاثة مؤشرات ستخبرنا بأكثر مما يخبرنا به أي بيان رسمي:

segments.src: **How many people remain after thirty days.** The gap between arrival figures and residual figures is the single clearest measure of whether return mechanisms functioned.
segments.tr: **كم عدد الأشخاص المتبقين بعد ثلاثين يوماً.** الفجوة بين أرقام الواصلين والأرقام المتبقية هي القياس المباشر والأوضح لما إذا كانت آليات الإعادة قد عملت كالمعتاد.

segments.src: **Whether the solidarity mechanism is actually triggered.** The Pact's relocation provisions have not been tested under genuine pressure.
segments.tr: **ما إذا كانت آلية التضامن ستفعل فعلياً.** أحكام إعادة التوطين في الميثاق لم تُختبر تحت ضغط حقيقي.

segments.src: This is the test.
segments.tr: هذا هو الاختبار.

segments.src: **Whether other member states treat this as a Spanish problem.** In 2015 they did not, initially, and the delay shaped the following decade.
segments.tr: **ما إذا كانت الدول الأعضاء الأخرى ستعامل هذا كـ مشكلة إسبانية.** في عام 2015 لم يفعلوا ذلك في البداية، وصاغ التأخير العقد التالي.

segments.src: The institutional question is whether anything learned since has changed the reflex.
segments.tr: السؤال المؤسسي هو ما إذا كان أي شيء تم تعلمه منذ ذلك الحين قد غير رد الفعل التلقائي.

segments.src: The barrier at Tarajal will likely get built.
segments.tr: من المرجح أن يتم بناء الحاجز في تاراخال.

segments.src: It will likely work, in the narrow sense that it closes a specific gap.
segments.tr: ومن المرجح أن يعمل، بالمعنى الضيق المتمثل في إغلاق فجوة محددة.

segments.src: The harder question — what Europe does when the country on the other side of the fence stops holding the line, and there is nowhere to put the people who arrive — remains exactly as unanswered as it was in 2021.
segments.tr: أما السؤال الأصعب — ماذا تفعل أوروبا عندما يتوقف البلد الموجود على الجانب الآخر من السياج عن الضبط، ولا يوجد مكان لوضع الأشخاص الواصلين — فيظل غير مجاب عليه تماماً كما كان في عام 2021.

segments.src: **A note on the figures:** Arrival and casualty numbers in fast-moving border events are typically compiled from multiple agencies under difficult conditions and are frequently revised, sometimes substantially, in the weeks that follow.
segments.tr: **ملاحظة بشأن الأرقام:** عادةً ما تُجمع أرقام الواصلين والضحايا في الأحداث الحدودية المتسارعة من وكالات متعددة في ظل ظروف صعبة، وغالباً ما تُراجع وتعدل، وأحياناً بشكل كبير، في الأسابيع التالية.

segments.src: The figures cited here reflect early official and press reporting and should be treated as provisional.
segments.tr: الأرقام المذكورة هنا تعكس التقارير الرسمية والصحفية المبكرة وينبغي التعامل معها كأرقام مؤقتة.

segments.src: Historical comparisons and background in this article draw on the documented record of the 2021 Ceuta crossings and subsequent Spanish and EU policy measures.
segments.tr: تستند المقارنات التاريخية والخلفية في هذا المقال إلى السجل الموثق لعمليات عبور سبتة عام 2021 والتدابير السياسية اللاحقة لإسبانيا والاتحاد الأوروبي.

fr.title: 60 000 personnes en 36 heures : ce que la ruée à la frontière de Ceuta révèle sur la prochaine crise migratoire européenne

segments.src: A city smaller than most American airports just became the most important place in European migration policy.
segments.tr: Une ville plus petite que la plupart des aéroports américains vient de devenir le lieu le plus important de la politique migratoire européenne.

segments.src: Reported figures put the number of people who crossed from Morocco into Ceuta — Spain's tiny enclave on the North African coast — at roughly 60,000 over about a day and a half.
segments.tr: Les chiffres rapportés évaluent le nombre de personnes ayant traversé du Maroc vers Ceuta — la minuscule enclave espagnole sur la côte nord-africaine — à environ 60 000 en un jour et demi environ.

segments.src: Spanish authorities have cited a death toll of 67.
segments.tr: Les autorités espagnoles ont fait état d'un bilan de 67 morts.

segments.src: Madrid has responded by accelerating construction of a sea barrier at the coastal edge of the border, the one section of the frontier that a fence has never been able to close.
segments.tr: Madrid a réagi en accélérant la construction d'une barrière maritime à la limite côtière de la frontière, le seul tronçon que la clôture n'a jamais pu fermer.

segments.src: Those numbers are still preliminary, and they will almost certainly be revised.
segments.tr: Ces chiffres sont encore préliminaires et seront très certainement révisés.

segments.src: But even at a fraction of their reported scale, the event exposes something that years of EU summits have carefully avoided saying out loud: Europe's external border is not a line on a map.
segments.tr: Mais même à une fraction de leur ampleur signalée, l'événement met en lumière ce que des années de sommets de l'UE ont soigneusement évité de dire tout haut : la frontière extérieure de l'Europe n'est pas une ligne sur une carte.

segments.src: It is a handful of specific, physically small chokepoints, and several of them can be overwhelmed in a weekend.
segments.tr: C'est une poignée de points de passage spécifiques et physiquement restreints, et plusieurs d'entre eux peuvent être submergés en un week-end.

segments.src: ## A city the size of a large airport
segments.tr: ## Une ville de la taille d'un grand aéroport

segments.src: Ceuta covers roughly seven to nine square miles, depending on how you count the port and the military zones.
segments.tr: Ceuta couvre environ sept à neuf milles carrés, selon la façon dont on compte le port et les zones militaires.

segments.src: About 83,000 people live there.
segments.tr: Environ 83 000 personnes y vivent.

segments.src: It is separated from mainland Spain by fourteen kilometers of the Strait of Gibraltar and connected by a ferry that takes about an hour to reach Algeciras.
segments.tr: Elle est séparée de l'Espagne continentale par quatorze kilomètres du détroit de Gibraltar et reliée par un ferry qui met environ une heure pour rejoindre Algésiras.

segments.src: Its land border with Morocco runs roughly eight kilometers and is fenced along nearly its entire length.
segments.tr: Sa frontière terrestre avec le Maroc s'étend sur environ huit kilomètres et est clôturée sur presque toute sa longueur.

segments.src: Spain's reception center for migrants in the city — the CETI — was built to hold a little over 500 people.
segments.tr: Le centre d'accueil pour migrants de l'Espagne dans la ville — le CETI — a été construit pour accueillir un peu plus de 500 personnes.

segments.src: It has routinely operated above that.
segments.tr: Il a régulièrement fonctionné au-dessus de cette capacité.

segments.src: Set the reported arrival figure against that capacity and the arithmetic stops being a policy question and becomes a logistics emergency.
segments.tr: Mettez le chiffre des arrivées rapporté en regard de cette capacité, et l'arithmétique cesse d'être une question politique pour devenir une urgence logistique.

segments.src: A single-digit multiple of the center's capacity is a crisis.
segments.tr: Un multiple à un seul chiffre de la capacité du centre constitue une crise.

segments.src: A hundredfold is something for which no contingency plan exists in any European interior ministry.
segments.tr: Un centuple est une situation pour laquelle aucun plan d'urgence n'existe dans aucun ministère de l'Intérieur européen.

segments.src: This is the structural fact that gets lost in debates about quotas and returns.
segments.tr: C'est le fait structurel qui se perd dans les débats sur les quotas et les renvois.

segments.src: Spain's enclaves are not a border region with room to absorb pressure.
segments.tr: Les enclaves espagnoles ne sont pas une région frontalière disposant d'espace pour absorber la pression.

segments.src: They are two small cities — Ceuta and Melilla, the latter smaller still — where the entire buffer between "managed" and "unmanageable" is measured in a few hundred beds.
segments.tr: Ce sont deux petites villes — Ceuta et Melilla, cette dernière étant encore plus petite — où l'ensemble de la zone tampon entre « géré » et « ingérable » se mesure en quelques centaines de lits.

segments.src: ## Why the sea, and not the fence
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la mer, et non la clôture

segments.src: The Ceuta fence has been raised, reinforced, fitted with sensors, and stripped of its razor wire and refitted again across two decades of Spanish governments.
segments.tr: La clôture de Ceuta a été rehaussée, renforcée, équipée de capteurs, dépouillée de ses barbelés et rééquipée au fil de deux décennies de gouvernements espagnols successifs.

segments.src: It works reasonably well at what it was designed to do.
segments.tr: Elle fonctionne raisonnablement bien pour ce pour quoi elle a été conçue.

segments.src: What it was never designed to do is close the water.
segments.tr: Ce pour quoi elle n'a jamais été conçue, c'est de fermer l'eau.

segments.src: At Tarajal, the border meets the Mediterranean.
segments.tr: À Tarajal, la frontière rencontre la Méditerranée.

segments.src: The fence ends, and beyond it there is a short stretch of shallow sea that can be swum or waded around at low tide.
segments.tr: La clôture s'arrête, et au-delà se trouve une courte étendue de mer peu profonde qui peut être traversée à la nage ou à pied à marée basse.

segments.src: Historically this was a marginal route.
segments.tr: Historiquement, c'était une route marginale.

segments.src: In May 2021, when roughly 8,000 people entered Ceuta over about two days after Moroccan border officials stood down, it became the primary one — thousands simply walked and swam around the end of the barrier in full view of cameras.
segments.tr: En mai 2021, lorsque environ 8 000 personnes sont entrées à Ceuta en deux jours environ après le retrait des gardes-frontières marocains, elle est devenue la route principale — des milliers de personnes ont simplement marché et nagé autour de l'extrémité de la barrière, sous les yeux des caméras.

segments.src: Spain drew the obvious conclusion and began extending a breakwater into the sea to physically close that gap.
segments.tr: L'Espagne en a tiré la conclusion évidente et a commencé à prolonger une digue dans la mer pour colmater physiquement cette brèche.

segments.src: The current push is an acceleration of that project, not a new idea.
segments.tr: La poussée actuelle est une accélération de ce projet, pas une idée nouvelle.

segments.src: Whether it changes the underlying dynamic is a separate question.
segments.tr: Quant à savoir si cela modifie la dynamique sous-jacente, c'est une autre question.

segments.src: A sea barrier converts an easy crossing into a harder one; it does not reduce the number of people who want to cross, and it introduces its own risks in open water — which is the most plausible context for a death toll of this size.
segments.tr: Une barrière maritime transforme une traversée facile en une traversée plus difficile ; elle ne réduit pas le nombre de personnes souhaitant traverser, et elle introduit ses propres risques en eau libre — ce qui constitue le contexte le plus plausible pour un bilan humain de cette ampleur.

segments.src: ## The part everyone understands and no one states
segments.tr: ## La partie que tout le monde comprend et que personne n'exprime

segments.src: Ceuta's border does not fail at random.
segments.tr: La frontière de Ceuta ne cède pas au hasard.

segments.src: It fails when Moroccan enforcement on the other side changes.
segments.tr: Elle cède lorsque les mesures de contrôle marocaines de l'autre côté changent.

segments.src: In 2021, Spanish officials were unusually direct in linking that month's surge to a diplomatic rupture over Western Sahara, after Spain admitted the leader of the Polisario Front for medical treatment.
segments.tr: En 2021, les responsables espagnols ont été particulièrement directs en liant l'afflux de ce mois-là à une rupture diplomatique concernant le Sahara occidental, après que l'Espagne a admis le chef du Front Polisario pour des soins médicaux.

segments.src: The border pressure eased once the political dispute was addressed.
segments.tr: La pression frontalière s'est apaisée une fois le différend politique traité.

segments.src: Spain subsequently shifted its formal position on Western Sahara in 2022, and relations were repaired.
segments.tr: L'Espagne a ensuite modifié sa position officielle sur le Sahara occidental en 2022, et les relations ont été rétablies.

segments.src: That episode established a pattern that European analysts now treat as a permanent feature of the file: enforcement cooperation at the enclaves is a diplomatic variable, not a fixed condition.
segments.tr: Cet épisode a établi un modèle que les analystes européens considèrent désormais comme une caractéristique permanente du dossier : la coopération en matière de contrôle aux enclaves est une variable diplomatique, non une condition fixe.

segments.src: The same dynamic has appeared on other EU frontiers, notably at the Belarus–Poland and Belarus–Lithuania borders.
segments.tr: La même dynamique est apparue sur d'autres frontières de l'UE, notamment aux frontières entre la Biélorussie et la Pologne ainsi qu'entre la Biélorussie et la Lituanie.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Il convient d'être prudent ici.

segments.src: Attributing intent to any government on the basis of a border event in progress is exactly the sort of claim that tends not to survive contact with the record.
segments.tr: Attribuer des intentions à un gouvernement sur la base d'un événement frontalier en cours est exactement le type d'affirmation qui tend à ne pas résister à l'épreuve des faits.

segments.src: What can be said without speculation is narrower and more useful: Europe has built a migration system whose functioning depends on the continued cooperation of non-member states, and it has not built a version of that system that works when the cooperation stops.
segments.tr: Ce qui peut être dit sans spéculation est plus restreint et plus utile : l'Europe a construit un système migratoire dont le fonctionnement dépend de la coopération continue d'États non membres, et elle n'a pas conçu de version de ce système qui fonctionne lorsque cette coopération s'arrête.

segments.src: ## What EU law now allows — and what it doesn't
segments.tr: ## Ce que le droit de l'UE permet désormais — et ce qu'il ne permet pas

segments.src: The timing matters.
segments.tr: Le calendrier importe.

segments.src: Member states are in the middle of phasing in the EU's Pact on Migration and Asylum, the package agreed in 2024 after nearly a decade of deadlock.
segments.tr: Les États membres sont en train de mettre en œuvre progressivement le Pacte de l'UE sur la migration et l'asile, le paquet convenu en 2024 après près d'une décennie d'impasse.

segments.src: Its core provisions include mandatory border screening, accelerated procedures at external frontiers, and a solidarity mechanism under which states can accept relocations or pay in instead.
segments.tr: Ses dispositions fondamentales comprennent le filtrage obligatoire aux frontières, des procédures accélérées aux frontières extérieures et un mécanisme de solidarité en vertu duquel les États peuvent accepter des relocalisations ou verser une contribution financière à la place.

segments.src: The Pact also includes something built precisely for a scenario like this: rules covering situations where a third country is judged to be using migration as leverage.
segments.tr: Le Pacte comprend également un dispositif conçu précisément pour un scénario comme celui-ci : des règles couvrant les situations où un pays tiers est jugé utiliser la migration comme moyen de pression.

segments.src: In those cases, a member state can seek authorization to extend registration deadlines, apply border procedures more broadly, and access emergency support.
segments.tr: Dans ces cas, un État membre peut solliciter l'autorisation de prolonger les délais d'enregistrement, d'appliquer les procédures frontalières plus largement et d'accéder à un soutien d'urgence.

segments.src: The catch is that these are procedural tools.
segments.tr: Le piège est qu'il s'agit d'outils procéduraux.

segments.src: They give a government legal room to process arrivals more slowly and with fewer obligations.
segments.tr: Ils donnent à un gouvernement une marge juridique pour traiter les arrivées plus lentement et avec moins d'obligations.

segments.src: They do not create physical space in a seven-square-mile city, and they do not resolve the question of where people go afterward.
segments.tr: Ils ne créent pas d'espace physique dans une ville de sept milles carrés, et ils ne résolvent pas la question de savoir où vont les gens par la suite.

segments.src: Spain also retains an older instrument: a 1992 readmission agreement with Morocco allowing the return of people who entered irregularly, which it used extensively in 2021.
segments.tr: L'Espagne conserve également un instrument plus ancien : un accord de réadmission de 1992 avec le Maroc permettant le retour des personnes entrées de manière irrégulière, qu'elle a largement utilisé en 2021.

segments.src: And Spanish courts, along with the European Court of Human Rights in its 2020 Grand Chamber ruling on the enclaves, have permitted rapid returns at the border under specific conditions.
segments.tr: Et les tribunaux espagnols, ainsi que la Cour européenne des droits de l'homme dans son arrêt de la Grande Chambre de 2020 sur les enclaves, ont autorisé des retours rapides à la frontière sous des conditions spécifiques.

segments.src: Those conditions are contested by rights organizations, and their application at a scale like this would be litigated for years.
segments.tr: Ces conditions sont contestées par les organisations de défense des droits, et leur application à une telle échelle ferait l'objet de contentieux pendant des années.

segments.src: ## The minors question
segments.tr: ## La question des mineurs

segments.src: One detail from 2021 turned out to be more consequential than the headline number.
segments.tr: Un détail de 2021 s'est avéré plus lourd de conséquences que le chiffre global.

segments.src: Of the roughly 8,000 people who entered, an estimated 1,500 were unaccompanied minors — and minors cannot be summarily returned.
segments.tr: Sur les quelque 8 000 personnes qui sont entrées, on estime que 1 500 étaient des mineurs non accompagnés — et les mineurs ne peuvent pas faire l'objet d'un retour sommaire.

segments.src: They enter a protection system with legal obligations attached.
segments.tr: Ils entrent dans un système de protection assorti d'obligations légales.

segments.src: That single category dominated Spanish domestic politics for the next four years.
segments.tr: Cette seule catégorie a dominé la politique intérieure espagnole pendant les quatre années suivantes.

segments.src: It produced a prolonged standoff between the central government and regional administrations over who was responsible for housing and schooling them, and eventually a mandatory distribution mechanism to move minors out of the enclaves and the Canary Islands to other regions.
segments.tr: Elle a produit une impasse prolongée entre le gouvernement central et les administrations régionales sur la responsabilité de leur hébergement et de leur scolarisation, et finalement un mécanisme de répartition obligatoire pour déplacer les mineurs hors des enclaves et des îles Canaries vers d'autres régions.

segments.src: If the proportion holds anywhere near constant at the reported scale, this becomes the defining aspect of the aftermath.
segments.tr: Si la proportion reste à peu près constante à l'échelle rapportée, cela devient l'aspect déterminant des retombées.

segments.src: It is also the aspect least amenable to barriers, agreements, or emergency regulations — the obligations are individual, they attach immediately, and they last for years.
segments.tr: C'est aussi l'aspect le moins accessible aux barrières, aux accords ou aux réglementations d'urgence — les obligations sont individuelles, elles s'imposent immédiatement et durent des années.

segments.src: ## Why this is a stress test, not an anomaly
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi il s'agit d'un crash-test, pas d'une anomalie

segments.src: There is a comfortable reading available: Ceuta is a geographic oddity, a colonial-era remnant that generates problems no other European border has.
segments.tr: Une lecture rassurante est disponible : Ceuta est une curiosité géographique, un vestige de l'ère coloniale qui génère des problèmes qu'aucune autre frontière européenne ne connaît.

segments.src: That reading is half right and dangerously incomplete.
segments.tr: Cette lecture est à moitié exacte et dangereusement incomplète.

segments.src: What makes Ceuta instructive is not that it is unusual but that it is small enough to fail visibly and fast.
segments.tr: Ce qui rend Ceuta instructive n'est pas son caractère inhabituel, mais le fait qu'elle soit suffisamment petite pour faillir de manière visible et rapide.

segments.src: The same dependencies exist along the Libyan and Tunisian routes to Italy, the Turkish route to Greece, and the West African route to the Canaries.
segments.tr: Les mêmes dépendances existent le long des routes libyenne et tunisienne vers l'Italie, de la route turque vers la Grèce et de la route ouest-africaine vers les Canaries.

segments.src: The difference is that those systems degrade over months, which allows them to be managed as a political process.
segments.tr: La différence est que ces systèmes se dégradent sur des mois, ce qui permet de les gérer comme un processus politique.

segments.src: Ceuta degrades over hours, which does not.
segments.tr: Ceuta se dégrade en quelques heures, ce qui ne le permet pas.

segments.src: A policy framework that produces workable outcomes at the pace of a European Council meeting, and collapses at the pace of a weekend, has a specific and identifiable weakness.
segments.tr: Un cadre politique qui produit des résultats exploitables au rythme d'une réunion du Conseil européen, et qui s'effondre au rythme d'un week-end, présente une faiblesse spécifique et identifiable.

segments.src: Nine square miles just demonstrated it in public.
segments.tr: Neuf milles carrés viennent de le démontrer publiquement.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: Three indicators will say more than any communiqué:
segments.tr: Trois indicateurs en diront plus que n'importe quel communiqué :

segments.src: **How many people remain after thirty days.** The gap between arrival figures and residual figures is the single clearest measure of whether return mechanisms functioned.
segments.tr: **Combien de personnes restent après trente jours.** L'écart entre les chiffres d'arrivée et les chiffres résiduels est la mesure la plus claire de l'efficacité des mécanismes de retour.

segments.src: **Whether the solidarity mechanism is actually triggered.** The Pact's relocation provisions have not been tested under genuine pressure.
segments.tr: **Si le mécanisme de solidarité est réellement déclenché.** Les dispositions de relocalisation du Pacte n'ont pas été testées sous une pression réelle.

segments.src: This is the test.
segments.tr: C'est le test.

segments.src: **Whether other member states treat this as a Spanish problem.** In 2015 they did not, initially, and the delay shaped the following decade.
segments.tr: **Si les autres États membres traitent cela comme un problème espagnol.** En 2015, ils ne l'ont pas fait, initialement, et ce retard a façonné la décennie suivante.

segments.src: The institutional question is whether anything learned since has changed the reflex.
segments.tr: La question institutionnelle est de savoir si ce qui a été appris depuis a modifié ce réflexe.

segments.src: The barrier at Tarajal will likely get built.
segments.tr: La barrière à Tarajal sera vraisemblablement construite.

segments.src: It will likely work, in the narrow sense that it closes a specific gap.
segments.tr: Elle fonctionnera vraisemblablement, au sens étroit où elle colmate une brèche spécifique.

segments.src: The harder question — what Europe does when the country on the other side of the fence stops holding the line, and there is nowhere to put the people who arrive — remains exactly as unanswered as it was in 2021.
segments.tr: La question la plus difficile — ce que fait l'Europe lorsque le pays de l'autre côté de la clôture cesse de tenir la ligne, et qu'il n'y a nulle part où placer les personnes qui arrivent — reste exactement aussi sans réponse qu'elle l'était en 2021.

segments.src: **A note on the figures:** Arrival and casualty numbers in fast-moving border events are typically compiled from multiple agencies under difficult conditions and are frequently revised, sometimes substantially, in the weeks that follow.
segments.tr: **Note sur les chiffres :** Les chiffres concernant les arrivées et les victimes lors d'événements frontaliers évoluant rapidement sont généralement compilés par plusieurs organismes dans des conditions difficiles et sont fréquemment révisés, parfois de manière substantielle, dans les semaines qui suivent.

segments.src: The figures cited here reflect early official and press reporting and should be treated as provisional.
segments.tr: Les chiffres cités ici reflètent les premiers rapports officiels et de presse et doivent être traités comme provisoires.

segments.src: Historical comparisons and background in this article draw on the documented record of the 2021 Ceuta crossings and subsequent Spanish and EU policy measures.
segments.tr: Les comparaisons historiques et le contexte présentés dans cet article s'appuient sur les archives documentées des traversées de Ceuta en 2021 et sur les mesures politiques ultérieures de l'Espagne et de l'UE.

pt.title: 60.000 pessoas em 36 horas: o que a onda migratória em Ceuta diz sobre a próxima crise migratória da Europa

segments.src: A city smaller than most American airports just became the most important place in European migration policy.
segments.tr: Uma cidade menor que a maioria dos aeroportos americanos acaba de se tornar o lugar mais importante da política migratória europeia.

segments.src: Reported figures put the number of people who crossed from Morocco into Ceuta — Spain's tiny enclave on the North African coast — at roughly 60,000 over about a day and a half.
segments.tr: Dados divulgados apontam que o número de pessoas que cruzaram do Marrocos para Ceuta — o pequeno enclave da Espanha na costa do Norte da África — foi de cerca de 60.000 em cerca de um dia e meio.

segments.src: Spanish authorities have cited a death toll of 67.
segments.tr: As autoridades espanholas citaram um número de 67 mortos.

segments.src: Madrid has responded by accelerating construction of a sea barrier at the coastal edge of the border, the one section of the frontier that a fence has never been able to close.
segments.tr: Madri respondeu acelerando a construção de uma barreira marítima na extremidade costeira da fronteira, o único trecho da fronteira que uma cerca nunca conseguiu fechar.

segments.src: Those numbers are still preliminary, and they will almost certainly be revised.
segments.tr: Esses números ainda são preliminares e quase certamente serão revisados.

segments.src: But even at a fraction of their reported scale, the event exposes something that years of EU summits have carefully avoided saying out loud: Europe's external border is not a line on a map.
segments.tr: Mas mesmo a uma fração da escala relatada, o evento expõe algo que anos de cúpulas da UE evitaram cuidadosamente dizer em voz alta: a fronteira externa da Europa não é uma linha em um mapa.

segments.src: It is a handful of specific, physically small chokepoints, and several of them can be overwhelmed in a weekend.
segments.tr: É um punhado de gargalos específicos e fisicamente pequenos, e vários deles podem ser sobrecarregados em um fim de semana.

segments.src: ## A city the size of a large airport
segments.tr: ## Uma cidade do tamanho de um grande aeroporto

segments.src: Ceuta covers roughly seven to nine square miles, depending on how you count the port and the military zones.
segments.tr: Ceuta cobre cerca de sete a nove milhas quadradas, dependendo de como você conta o porto e as zonas militares.

segments.src: About 83,000 people live there.
segments.tr: Cerca de 83.000 pessoas vivem lá.

segments.src: It is separated from mainland Spain by fourteen kilometers of the Strait of Gibraltar and connected by a ferry that takes about an hour to reach Algeciras.
segments.tr: Ela é separada da Espanha continental por catorze quilômetros do Estreito de Gibraltar e conectada por uma balsa que leva cerca de uma hora para chegar a Algeciras.

segments.src: Its land border with Morocco runs roughly eight kilometers and is fenced along nearly its entire length.
segments.tr: Sua fronteira terrestre com o Marrocos tem cerca de oito quilômetros e é cercada ao longo de quase toda a sua extensão.

segments.src: Spain's reception center for migrants in the city — the CETI — was built to hold a little over 500 people.
segments.tr: O centro de recepção para migrantes da Espanha na cidade — o CETI — foi construído para abrigar um pouco mais de 500 pessoas.

segments.src: It has routinely operated above that.
segments.tr: Ele tem operado rotineiramente acima disso.

segments.src: Set the reported arrival figure against that capacity and the arithmetic stops being a policy question and becomes a logistics emergency.
segments.tr: Coloque o número de chegadas relatado em relação a essa capacidade e a aritmética deixa de ser uma questão de política e se torna uma emergência logística.

segments.src: A single-digit multiple of the center's capacity is a crisis.
segments.tr: Um múltiplo de um único dígito da capacidade do centro é uma crise.

segments.src: A hundredfold is something for which no contingency plan exists in any European interior ministry.
segments.tr: Cem vezes é algo para o qual não existe plano de contingência em nenhum ministério do interior europeu.

segments.src: This is the structural fact that gets lost in debates about quotas and returns.
segments.tr: Este é o fato estrutural que se perde nos debates sobre cotas e devoluções.

segments.src: Spain's enclaves are not a border region with room to absorb pressure.
segments.tr: Os enclaves da Espanha não são uma região de fronteira com espaço para absorver pressão.

segments.src: They are two small cities — Ceuta and Melilla, the latter smaller still — where the entire buffer between "managed" and "unmanageable" is measured in a few hundred beds.
segments.tr: Eles são duas pequenas cidades — Ceuta e Melilla, esta última ainda menor — onde todo o amortecedor entre o "gerenciável" e o "ingerenciável" é medido em algumas centenas de leitos.

segments.src: ## Why the sea, and not the fence
segments.tr: ## Por que o mar, e não a cerca

segments.src: The Ceuta fence has been raised, reinforced, fitted with sensors, and stripped of its razor wire and refitted again across two decades of Spanish governments.
segments.tr: A cerca de Ceuta foi elevada, reforçada, equipada com sensores, desprovida de seu arame farpado e reequipada novamente ao longo de duas décadas de governos espanhóis.

segments.src: It works reasonably well at what it was designed to do.
segments.tr: Ela funciona razoavelmente bem no que foi projetada para fazer.

segments.src: What it was never designed to do is close the water.
segments.tr: O que ela nunca foi projetada para fazer é fechar a água.

segments.src: At Tarajal, the border meets the Mediterranean.
segments.tr: Em Tarajal, a fronteira encontra o Mediterrâneo.

segments.src: The fence ends, and beyond it there is a short stretch of shallow sea that can be swum or waded around at low tide.
segments.tr: A cerca termina e, além dela, há um curto trecho de mar raso que pode ser percorrido a nado ou a pé na maré baixa.

segments.src: Historically this was a marginal route.
segments.tr: Historicamente, essa era uma rota marginal.

segments.src: In May 2021, when roughly 8,000 people entered Ceuta over about two days after Moroccan border officials stood down, it became the primary one — thousands simply walked and swam around the end of the barrier in full view of cameras.
segments.tr: Em maio de 2021, quando cerca de 8.000 pessoas entraram em Ceuta em cerca de dois dias após as autoridades de fronteira marroquinas se retirarem, ela se tornou a principal — milhares simplesmente caminharam e nadaram ao redor do fim da barreira à vista de câmeras.

segments.src: Spain drew the obvious conclusion and began extending a breakwater into the sea to physically close that gap.
segments.tr: A Espanha tirou a conclusão óbvia e começou a estender um quebra-mar no mar para fechar fisicamente essa lacuna.

segments.src: The current push is an acceleration of that project, not a new idea.
segments.tr: O esforço atual é uma aceleração desse projeto, não uma ideia nova.

segments.src: Whether it changes the underlying dynamic is a separate question.
segments.tr: Se isso muda a dinâmica subjacente é uma questão separada.

segments.src: A sea barrier converts an easy crossing into a harder one; it does not reduce the number of people who want to cross, and it introduces its own risks in open water — which is the most plausible context for a death toll of this size.
segments.tr: Uma barreira marítima converte uma travessia fácil em uma mais difícil; não reduz o número de pessoas que querem atravessar e introduz seus próprios riscos em águas abertas — que é o contexto mais plausível para um número de mortos desse tamanho.

segments.src: ## The part everyone understands and no one states
segments.tr: ## A parte que todo mundo entende e ninguém declara

segments.src: Ceuta's border does not fail at random.
segments.tr: A fronteira de Ceuta não falha ao acaso.

segments.src: It fails when Moroccan enforcement on the other side changes.
segments.tr: Ela falha quando a fiscalização marroquina do outro lado muda.

segments.src: In 2021, Spanish officials were unusually direct in linking that month's surge to a diplomatic rupture over Western Sahara, after Spain admitted the leader of the Polisario Front for medical treatment.
segments.tr: Em 2021, autoridades espanholas foram incomumente diretas ao vincular o pico daquele mês a uma ruptura diplomática sobre o Saara Ocidental, depois que a Espanha admitiu o líder da Frente Polisário para tratamento médico.

segments.src: The border pressure eased once the political dispute was addressed.
segments.tr: A pressão na fronteira diminuiu assim que a disputa política foi resolvida.

segments.src: Spain subsequently shifted its formal position on Western Sahara in 2022, and relations were repaired.
segments.tr: A Espanha subsequentemente mudou sua posição formal sobre o Saara Ocidental em 2022, e as relações foram restabelecidas.

segments.src: That episode established a pattern that European analysts now treat as a permanent feature of the file: enforcement cooperation at the enclaves is a diplomatic variable, not a fixed condition.
segments.tr: Aquele episódio estabeleceu um padrão que analistas europeus agora tratam como uma característica permanente do dossiê: a cooperação na fiscalização nos enclaves é uma variável diplomática, não uma condição fixa.

segments.src: The same dynamic has appeared on other EU frontiers, notably at the Belarus–Poland and Belarus–Lithuania borders.
segments.tr: A mesma dinâmica apareceu em outras fronteiras da UE, notadamente nas fronteiras Bielo-Rússia–Polônia e Bielo-Rússia–Lituânia.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Cuidado aqui é importante.

segments.src: Attributing intent to any government on the basis of a border event in progress is exactly the sort of claim that tends not to survive contact with the record.
segments.tr: Atribuir intenção a qualquer governo com base em um evento de fronteira em andamento é exatamente o tipo de alegação que tende a não sobreviver ao confronto com os fatos.

segments.src: What can be said without speculation is narrower and more useful: Europe has built a migration system whose functioning depends on the continued cooperation of non-member states, and it has not built a version of that system that works when the cooperation stops.
segments.tr: O que pode ser dito sem especulação é mais restrito e mais útil: a Europa construiu um sistema de migração cujo funcionamento depende da cooperação contínua de países não membros, e não construiu uma versão desse sistema que funcione quando a cooperação para.

segments.src: ## What EU law now allows — and what it doesn't
segments.tr: ## O que a lei da UE agora permite — e o que não permite

segments.src: The timing matters.
segments.tr: O momento importa.

segments.src: Member states are in the middle of phasing in the EU's Pact on Migration and Asylum, the package agreed in 2024 after nearly a decade of deadlock.
segments.tr: Os Estados-membros estão no meio da implementação progressiva do Pacto sobre Migração e Asilo da UE, o pacote acordado em 2024 após quase uma década de impasse.

segments.src: Its core provisions include mandatory border screening, accelerated procedures at external frontiers, and a solidarity mechanism under which states can accept relocations or pay in instead.
segments.tr: Suas disposições fundamentais incluem triagem obrigatória nas fronteiras, procedimentos acelerados nas fronteiras externas e um mecanismo de solidariedade sob o qual os estados podem aceitar recolocações ou pagar em substituição.

segments.src: The Pact also includes something built precisely for a scenario like this: rules covering situations where a third country is judged to be using migration as leverage.
segments.tr: O Pacto também inclui algo construído precisamente para um cenário como este: regras que cobrem situações em que um país terceiro é julgado como usando a migração como instrumento de pressão.

segments.src: In those cases, a member state can seek authorization to extend registration deadlines, apply border procedures more broadly, and access emergency support.
segments.tr: Nesses casos, um Estado-membro pode solicitar autorização para prorrogar prazos de registro, aplicar procedimentos de fronteira de forma mais ampla e acessar apoio de emergência.

segments.src: The catch is that these are procedural tools.
segments.tr: O ponto central é que essas são ferramentas procedimentais.

segments.src: They give a government legal room to process arrivals more slowly and with fewer obligations.
segments.tr: Elas dão a um governo margem jurídica para processar chegadas mais lentamente e com menos obrigações.

segments.src: They do not create physical space in a seven-square-mile city, and they do not resolve the question of where people go afterward.
segments.tr: Elas não criam espaço físico em uma cidade de sete milhas quadradas e não resolvem a questão de para onde as pessoas vão depois.

segments.src: Spain also retains an older instrument: a 1992 readmission agreement with Morocco allowing the return of people who entered irregularly, which it used extensively in 2021.
segments.tr: A Espanha também mantém um instrumento mais antigo: um acordo de readmissão de 1992 com o Marrocos que permite a devolução de pessoas que entraram irregularmente, o qual usou extensivamente em 2021.

segments.src: And Spanish courts, along with the European Court of Human Rights in its 2020 Grand Chamber ruling on the enclaves, have permitted rapid returns at the border under specific conditions.
segments.tr: E os tribunais espanhóis, juntamente com o Tribunal Europeu dos Direitos Humanos em sua decisão da Grande Câmara de 2020 sobre os enclaves, permitiram devoluções rápidas na fronteira sob condições específicas.

segments.src: Those conditions are contested by rights organizations, and their application at a scale like this would be litigated for years.
segments.tr: Essas condições são contestadas por organizações de direitos humanos, e sua aplicação em uma escala como esta seria objeto de litígio por anos.

segments.src: ## The minors question
segments.tr: ## A questão dos menores

segments.src: One detail from 2021 turned out to be more consequential than the headline number.
segments.tr: Um detalhe de 2021 revelou-se mais consequente do que o número principal.

segments.src: Of the roughly 8,000 people who entered, an estimated 1,500 were unaccompanied minors — and minors cannot be summarily returned.
segments.tr: Das cerca de 8.000 pessoas que entraram, estima-se que 1.500 eram menores não acompanhados — e menores não podem ser devolvidos sumariamente.

segments.src: They enter a protection system with legal obligations attached.
segments.tr: Eles entram em um sistema de proteção com obrigações legais vinculadas.

segments.src: That single category dominated Spanish domestic politics for the next four years.
segments.tr: Essa única categoria dominou a política interna espanhola nos quatro anos seguintes.

segments.src: It produced a prolonged standoff between the central government and regional administrations over who was responsible for housing and schooling them, and eventually a mandatory distribution mechanism to move minors out of the enclaves and the Canary Islands to other regions.
segments.tr: Produziu um impasse prolongado entre o governo central e as administrações regionais sobre quem era responsável por abrigá-los e escolarizá-los, e eventualmente um mecanismo de distribuição obrigatório para mover menores dos enclaves e das Ilhas Canárias para outras regiões.

segments.src: If the proportion holds anywhere near constant at the reported scale, this becomes the defining aspect of the aftermath.
segments.tr: Se a proporção se mantiver próxima de constante na escala relatada, este se torna o aspecto definidor das consequências.

segments.src: It is also the aspect least amenable to barriers, agreements, or emergency regulations — the obligations are individual, they attach immediately, and they last for years.
segments.tr: É também o aspecto menos suscetível a barreiras, acordos ou regulamentos de emergência — as obrigações são individuais, aplicam-se imediatamente e duram anos.

segments.src: ## Why this is a stress test, not an anomaly
segments.tr: ## Por que isto é um teste de estresse, não uma anomalia

segments.src: There is a comfortable reading available: Ceuta is a geographic oddity, a colonial-era remnant that generates problems no other European border has.
segments.tr: Há uma leitura confortável disponível: Ceuta é uma raridade geográfica, um remanescente da era colonial que gera problemas que nenhuma outra fronteira europeia tem.

segments.src: That reading is half right and dangerously incomplete.
segments.tr: Essa leitura está meio certa e é perigosamente incompleta.

segments.src: What makes Ceuta instructive is not that it is unusual but that it is small enough to fail visibly and fast.
segments.tr: O que torna Ceuta instrutiva não é o fato de ser incomum, mas o fato de ser pequena o suficiente para falhar visivelmente e rápido.

segments.src: The same dependencies exist along the Libyan and Tunisian routes to Italy, the Turkish route to Greece, and the West African route to the Canaries.
segments.tr: As mesmas dependências existem ao longo das rotas líbia e tunisiana para a Itália, da rota turca para a Grécia e da rota da África Ocidental para as Canárias.

segments.src: The difference is that those systems degrade over months, which allows them to be managed as a political process.
segments.tr: A diferença é que esses sistemas se degradam ao longo de meses, o que permite que sejam gerenciados como um processo político.

segments.src: Ceuta degrades over hours, which does not.
segments.tr: Ceuta se degrada ao longo de horas, o que não acontece.

segments.src: A policy framework that produces workable outcomes at the pace of a European Council meeting, and collapses at the pace of a weekend, has a specific and identifiable weakness.
segments.tr: Uma estrutura de políticas que produz resultados viáveis no ritmo de uma reunião do Conselho Europeu, e colapsa no ritmo de um fim de semana, tem uma fraqueza específica e identificável.

segments.src: Nine square miles just demonstrated it in public.
segments.tr: Nove milhas quadradas acabaram de demonstrá-la publicamente.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: Three indicators will say more than any communiqué:
segments.tr: Três indicadores dirão mais do que qualquer comunicado:

segments.src: **How many people remain after thirty days.** The gap between arrival figures and residual figures is the single clearest measure of whether return mechanisms functioned.
segments.tr: **Quantas pessoas permanecem após trinta dias.** A lacuna entre os números de chegada e os números residuais é a medida individual mais clara de se os mecanismos de devolução funcionaram.

segments.src: **Whether the solidarity mechanism is actually triggered.** The Pact's relocation provisions have not been tested under genuine pressure.
segments.tr: **Se o mecanismo de solidariedade é realmente acionado.** As disposições de recolocação do Pacto não foram testadas sob pressão real.

segments.src: This is the test.
segments.tr: Este é o teste.

segments.src: **Whether other member states treat this as a Spanish problem.** In 2015 they did not, initially, and the delay shaped the following decade.
segments.tr: **Se outros Estados-membros tratam isso como um problema espanhol.** Em 2015 eles não trataram, inicialmente, e o atraso moldou a década seguinte.

segments.src: The institutional question is whether anything learned since has changed the reflex.
segments.tr: A questão institucional é se algo aprendido desde então mudou o reflexo.

segments.src: The barrier at Tarajal will likely get built.
segments.tr: A barreira em Tarajal provavelmente será construída.

segments.src: It will likely work, in the narrow sense that it closes a specific gap.
segments.tr: Ela provavelmente funcionará, no sentido estrito de fechar uma lacuna específica.

segments.src: The harder question — what Europe does when the country on the other side of the fence stops holding the line, and there is nowhere to put the people who arrive — remains exactly as unanswered as it was in 2021.
segments.tr: A questão mais difícil — o que a Europa faz quando o país do outro lado da cerca para de reter o fluxo e não há onde colocar as pessoas que chegam — permanece exatamente tão sem resposta quanto estava em 2021.

segments.src: **A note on the figures:** Arrival and casualty numbers in fast-moving border events are typically compiled from multiple agencies under difficult conditions and are frequently revised, sometimes substantially, in the weeks that follow.
segments.tr: **Uma nota sobre os números:** Números de chegadas e vítimas em eventos de fronteira em rápida evolução são tipicamente compilados por várias agências sob condições difíceis e são frequentemente revisados, às vezes substancialmente, nas semanas seguintes.

segments.src: The figures cited here reflect early official and press reporting and should be treated as provisional.
segments.tr: Os números citados aqui refletem relatos oficiais e da imprensa iniciais e devem ser tratados como provisórios.

segments.src: Historical comparisons and background in this article draw on the documented record of the 2021 Ceuta crossings and subsequent Spanish and EU policy measures.
segments.tr: Comparações históricas e o contexto deste artigo baseiam-se no registro documentado dos cruzamentos de Ceuta em 2021 e subsequentes medidas de política da Espanha e da UE.

in.title: 60.000 Orang dalam 36 Jam: Apa yang Diungkapkan Lonjakan Perbatasan Ceuta tentang Krisis Migrasi Eropa Berikutnya

segments.src: A city smaller than most American airports just became the most important place in European migration policy.
segments.tr: Sebuah kota yang lebih kecil dari sebagian besar bandara di Amerika baru saja menjadi tempat paling penting dalam kebijakan migrasi Eropa.

segments.src: Reported figures put the number of people who crossed from Morocco into Ceuta — Spain's tiny enclave on the North African coast — at roughly 60,000 over about a day and a half.
segments.tr: Angka-angka yang dilaporkan menunjukkan jumlah orang yang menyeberang dari Maroko ke Ceuta — enklave kecil Spanyol di pantai Afrika Utara — sekitar 60.000 orang dalam waktu sekitar satu setengah hari.

segments.src: Spanish authorities have cited a death toll of 67.
segments.tr: Otoritas Spanyol mencatat korban tewas sebanyak 67 orang.

segments.src: Madrid has responded by accelerating construction of a sea barrier at the coastal edge of the border, the one section of the frontier that a fence has never been able to close.
segments.tr: Madrid merespons dengan mempercepat pembangunan penghalang laut di tepi pantai perbatasan, satu-satunya bagian perbatasan yang tidak pernah bisa ditutup oleh pagar.

segments.src: Those numbers are still preliminary, and they will almost certainly be revised.
segments.tr: Angka-angka tersebut masih bersifat sementara, dan hampir pasti akan direvisi.

segments.src: But even at a fraction of their reported scale, the event exposes something that years of EU summits have carefully avoided saying out loud: Europe's external border is not a line on a map.
segments.tr: Namun bahkan pada sebagian kecil dari skala yang dilaporkan, peristiwa ini mengungkap sesuatu yang selama bertahun-tahun dihindari secara hati-hati oleh KTT UE untuk diungkapkan secara terbuka: perbatasan luar Eropa bukanlah sebuah garis di peta.

segments.src: It is a handful of specific, physically small chokepoints, and several of them can be overwhelmed in a weekend.
segments.tr: Ini adalah sejumlah titik penyempitan yang spesifik dan secara fisik kecil, dan beberapa di antaranya dapat kewalahan dalam satu akhir pekan.

segments.src: ## A city the size of a large airport
segments.tr: ## Sebuah kota seluas bandara besar

segments.src: Ceuta covers roughly seven to nine square miles, depending on how you count the port and the military zones.
segments.tr: Ceuta mencakup sekitar tujuh hingga sembilan mil persegi, tergantung pada bagaimana Anda menghitung pelabuhan dan zona militer.

segments.src: About 83,000 people live there.
segments.tr: Sekitar 83.000 orang tinggal di sana.

segments.src: It is separated from mainland Spain by fourteen kilometers of the Strait of Gibraltar and connected by a ferry that takes about an hour to reach Algeciras.
segments.tr: Kota ini dipisahkan dari daratan Spanyol oleh empat belas kilometer Selat Gibraltar dan dihubungkan oleh feri yang membutuhkan waktu sekitar satu jam untuk mencapai Algeciras.

segments.src: Its land border with Morocco runs roughly eight kilometers and is fenced along nearly its entire length.
segments.tr: Perbatasan daratnya dengan Maroko membentang sekitar delapan kilometer dan dipagari di hampir seluruh panjangnya.

segments.src: Spain's reception center for migrants in the city — the CETI — was built to hold a little over 500 people.
segments.tr: Pusat penerimaan migran Spanyol di kota tersebut — CETI — dibangun untuk menampung sedikit lebih dari 500 orang.

segments.src: It has routinely operated above that.
segments.tr: Fasilitas ini secara rutin beroperasi di atas kapasitas tersebut.

segments.src: Set the reported arrival figure against that capacity and the arithmetic stops being a policy question and becomes a logistics emergency.
segments.tr: Bandingkan angka kedatangan yang dilaporkan dengan kapasitas tersebut, dan perhitungannya berhenti menjadi pertanyaan kebijakan dan menjadi darurat logistik.

segments.src: A single-digit multiple of the center's capacity is a crisis.
segments.tr: Kelipatan satu digit dari kapasitas pusat tersebut adalah sebuah krisis.

segments.src: A hundredfold is something for which no contingency plan exists in any European interior ministry.
segments.tr: Ratusan kali lipat adalah sesuatu yang tidak memiliki rencana kontinjensi di kementerian dalam negeri Eropa mana pun.

segments.src: This is the structural fact that gets lost in debates about quotas and returns.
segments.tr: Ini adalah fakta struktural yang hilang dalam perdebatan tentang kuota dan pengembalian.

segments.src: Spain's enclaves are not a border region with room to absorb pressure.
segments.tr: Enklave Spanyol bukanlah wilayah perbatasan dengan ruang untuk menyerap tekanan.

segments.src: They are two small cities — Ceuta and Melilla, the latter smaller still — where the entire buffer between "managed" and "unmanageable" is measured in a few hundred beds.
segments.tr: Keduanya adalah dua kota kecil — Ceuta dan Melilla, yang terakhir bahkan lebih kecil — di mana seluruh penyangga antara "terkelola" dan "tidak terkelola" diukur dalam beberapa ratus tempat tidur.

segments.src: ## Why the sea, and not the fence
segments.tr: ## Mengapa laut, bukan pagar

segments.src: The Ceuta fence has been raised, reinforced, fitted with sensors, and stripped of its razor wire and refitted again across two decades of Spanish governments.
segments.tr: Pagar Ceuta telah ditinggikan, diperkuat, dilengkapi dengan sensor, dan dilepas kawat durinya lalu dipasang kembali selama dua dekade pemerintahan Spanyol.

segments.src: It works reasonably well at what it was designed to do.
segments.tr: Pagar ini berfungsi cukup baik sesuai tujuan pembuatannya.

segments.src: What it was never designed to do is close the water.
segments.tr: Apa yang tidak pernah dirancang untuk dilakukannya adalah menutup wilayah perairan.

segments.src: At Tarajal, the border meets the Mediterranean.
segments.tr: Di Tarajal, perbatasan bertemu dengan Laut Tengah.

segments.src: The fence ends, and beyond it there is a short stretch of shallow sea that can be swum or waded around at low tide.
segments.tr: Pagar berakhir, dan di baliknya terdapat membentang laut dangkal pendek que dapat direnangi atau diarungi saat air surut.

segments.src: Historically this was a marginal route.
segments.tr: Secara historis ini adalah rute marginal.

segments.src: In May 2021, when roughly 8,000 people entered Ceuta over about two days after Moroccan border officials stood down, it became the primary one — thousands simply walked and swam around the end of the barrier in full view of cameras.
segments.tr: Pada Mei 2021, ketika sekitar 8.000 orang memasuki Ceuta dalam waktu sekitar dua hari setelah petugas perbatasan Maroko mundur, rute ini menjadi rute utama — ribuan orang cukup berjalan dan berenang mengitari ujung penghalang di depan kamera.

segments.src: Spain drew the obvious conclusion and began extending a breakwater into the sea to physically close that gap.
segments.tr: Spanyol mengambil kesimpulan yang jelas dan mulai memperpanjang pemecah gelombang ke laut untuk menutup celah tersebut secara fisik.

segments.src: The current push is an acceleration of that project, not a new idea.
segments.tr: Dorongan saat ini adalah percepatan proyek tersebut, bukan ide baru.

segments.src: Whether it changes the underlying dynamic is a separate question.
segments.tr: Apakah hal itu mengubah dinamika mendasar adalah pertanyaan terpisah.

segments.src: A sea barrier converts an easy crossing into a harder one; it does not reduce the number of people who want to cross, and it introduces its own risks in open water — which is the most plausible context for a death toll of this size.
segments.tr: Penghalang laut mengubah penyeberangan yang mudah menjadi lebih sulit; itu tidak mengurangi jumlah orang yang ingin menyeberang, dan membawa risikonya sendiri di perairan terbuka — yang merupakan konteks paling masuk akal untuk jumlah korban tewas sebesar ini.

segments.src: ## The part everyone understands and no one states
segments.tr: ## Bagian yang dipahami semua orang dan tidak dinyatakan oleh siapa pun

segments.src: Ceuta's border does not fail at random.
segments.tr: Perbatasan Ceuta tidak gagal secara acak.

segments.src: It fails when Moroccan enforcement on the other side changes.
segments.tr: Perbatasan ini gagal ketika penegakan hukum Maroko di sisi lain berubah.

segments.src: In 2021, Spanish officials were unusually direct in linking that month's surge to a diplomatic rupture over Western Sahara, after Spain admitted the leader of the Polisario Front for medical treatment.
segments.tr: Pada tahun 2021, para pejabat Spanyol secara tidak biasa langsung mengaitkan lonjakan bulan itu dengan keretakan diplomatik atas Sahara Barat, setelah Spanyol mengizinkan pemimpin Front Polisario masuk untuk perawatan medis.

segments.src: The border pressure eased once the political dispute was addressed.
segments.tr: Tekanan perbatasan mereda setelah perselisihan politik ditangani.

segments.src: Spain subsequently shifted its formal position on Western Sahara in 2022, and relations were repaired.
segments.tr: Spanyol kemudian mengubah posisi resminya tentang Sahara Barat pada tahun 2022, dan hubungan pun dipulihkan.

segments.src: That episode established a pattern that European analysts now treat as a permanent feature of the file: enforcement cooperation at the enclaves is a diplomatic variable, not a fixed condition.
segments.tr: Episode tersebut membentuk pola yang kini diperlakukan oleh para analis Eropa sebagai fitur permanen dari berkas tersebut: kerja sama penegakan hukum di enklave adalah variabel diplomatik, bukan kondisi tetap.

segments.src: The same dynamic has appeared on other EU frontiers, notably at the Belarus–Poland and Belarus–Lithuania borders.
segments.tr: Dinamika serupa telah muncul di perbatasan UE lainnya, terutama di perbatasan Belarus–Polandia dan Belarus–Lituania.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Sangat penting untuk berhati-hati di sini.

segments.src: Attributing intent to any government on the basis of a border event in progress is exactly the sort of claim that tends not to survive contact with the record.
segments.tr: Mengatribusikan niat kepada pemerintah mana pun berdasarkan peristiwa perbatasan yang sedang berlangsung adalah jenis klaim yang cenderung tidak bertahan jika dihadapkan pada catatan sejarah.

segments.src: What can be said without speculation is narrower and more useful: Europe has built a migration system whose functioning depends on the continued cooperation of non-member states, and it has not built a version of that system that works when the cooperation stops.
segments.tr: Apa yang dapat dikatakan tanpa spekulasi lebih sempit dan lebih berguna: Eropa telah membangun sistem migrasi yang fungsinya bergantung pada kerja sama berkelanjutan dari negara-negara non-anggota, dan belum membangun versi sistem yang berfungsi ketika kerja sama tersebut berhenti.

segments.src: ## What EU law now allows — and what it doesn't
segments.tr: ## Apa yang diizinkan hukum UE saat ini — dan apa yang tidak

segments.src: The timing matters.
segments.tr: Waktunya sangat penting.

segments.src: Member states are in the middle of phasing in the EU's Pact on Migration and Asylum, the package agreed in 2024 after nearly a decade of deadlock.
segments.tr: Negara-negara anggota berada di tengah-tengah penerapan Pakta tentang Migrasi dan Suaka UE secara bertahap, paket yang disepakati pada tahun 2024 setelah kebuntuan selama hampir satu dekade.

segments.src: Its core provisions include mandatory border screening, accelerated procedures at external frontiers, and a solidarity mechanism under which states can accept relocations or pay in instead.
segments.tr: Ketentuan utamanya mencakup pemeriksaan perbatasan wajib, prosedur yang dipercepat di perbatasan luar, dan mekanisme solidaritas di mana negara-negara dapat menerima relokasi atau membayar sebagai gantinya.

segments.src: The Pact also includes something built precisely for a scenario like this: rules covering situations where a third country is judged to be using migration as leverage.
segments.tr: Pakta ini juga mencakup sesuatu yang dibangun khusus untuk skenario seperti ini: aturan yang mencakup situasi di mana negara ketiga dinilai menggunakan migrasi sebagai alat penekanan.

segments.src: In those cases, a member state can seek authorization to extend registration deadlines, apply border procedures more broadly, and access emergency support.
segments.tr: Dalam kasus-kasus tersebut, negara anggota dapat meminta otorisasi untuk memperpanjang tenggat waktu pendaftaran, menerapkan prosedur perbatasan secara lebih luas, dan mengakses dukungan darurat.

segments.src: The catch is that these are procedural tools.
segments.tr: Kendalanya adalah bahwa ini adalah alat prosedural.

segments.src: They give a government legal room to process arrivals more slowly and with fewer obligations.
segments.tr: Alat ini memberi pemerintah ruang hukum untuk memproses kedatangan secara lebih lambat dan dengan lebih sedikit kewajiban.

segments.src: They do not create physical space in a seven-square-mile city, and they do not resolve the question of where people go afterward.
segments.tr: Alat ini tidak menciptakan ruang fisik di kota seluas tujuh mil persegi, dan tidak menyelesaikan pertanyaan tentang ke mana orang-orang pergi setelahnya.

segments.src: Spain also retains an older instrument: a 1992 readmission agreement with Morocco allowing the return of people who entered irregularly, which it used extensively in 2021.
segments.tr: Spanyol juga mempertahankan instrumen yang lebih lama: perjanjian readmisi tahun 1992 dengan Maroko yang memungkinkan pengembalian orang-orang yang masuk secara tidak sah, yang digunakannya secara luas pada tahun 2021.

segments.src: And Spanish courts, along with the European Court of Human Rights in its 2020 Grand Chamber ruling on the enclaves, have permitted rapid returns at the border under specific conditions.
segments.tr: Dan pengadilan Spanyol, bersama dengan Mahkamah Hak Asasi Manusia Eropa dalam putusan Grand Chamber tahun 2020 tentang enklave tersebut, telah mengizinkan pengembalian cepat di perbatasan dalam kondisi tertentu.

segments.src: Those conditions are contested by rights organizations, and their application at a scale like this would be litigated for years.
segments.tr: Kondisi-kondisi tersebut ditentang oleh organisasi hak asasi manusia, dan penerapannya pada skala seperti ini akan diperkarakan di pengadilan selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: ## The minors question
segments.tr: ## Pertanyaan tentang anak di bawah umur

segments.src: One detail from 2021 turned out to be more consequential than the headline number.
segments.tr: Satu detail dari tahun 2021 ternyata lebih berdampak daripada angka utama.

segments.src: Of the roughly 8,000 people who entered, an estimated 1,500 were unaccompanied minors — and minors cannot be summarily returned.
segments.tr: Dari sekitar 8.000 orang yang masuk, diperkirakan 1.500 adalah anak di bawah umur tanpa pendamping — dan anak di bawah umur tidak dapat dikembalikan secara ringkas.

segments.src: They enter a protection system with legal obligations attached.
segments.tr: Mereka masuk ke dalam sistem perlindungan dengan kewajiban hukum yang menyertainya.

segments.src: That single category dominated Spanish domestic politics for the next four years.
segments.tr: Kategori tunggal itu mendominasi politik domestik Spanyol selama empat tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: It produced a prolonged standoff between the central government and regional administrations over who was responsible for housing and schooling them, and eventually a mandatory distribution mechanism to move minors out of the enclaves and the Canary Islands to other regions.
segments.tr: Hal ini menyebabkan perselisihan berkepanjangan antara pemerintah pusat dan pemerintah daerah mengenai siapa yang bertanggung jawab menampung dan menyekolahkan mereka, dan akhirnya mekanisme distribusi wajib untuk memindahkan anak di bawah umur dari enklave dan Kepulauan Kanari ke wilayah lain.

segments.src: If the proportion holds anywhere near constant at the reported scale, this becomes the defining aspect of the aftermath.
segments.tr: Jika proporsinya tetap konstan pada skala yang dilaporkan, ini menjadi aspek yang menentukan dari dampak setelahnya.

segments.src: It is also the aspect least amenable to barriers, agreements, or emergency regulations — the obligations are individual, they attach immediately, and they last for years.
segments.tr: Ini juga merupakan aspek yang paling tidak dapat diatasi oleh penghalang, perjanjian, atau Peraturan darurat — kewajibannya bersifat individu, berlaku segera, dan berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: ## Why this is a stress test, not an anomaly
segments.tr: ## Mengapa ini adalah uji stres, bukan anomali

segments.src: There is a comfortable reading available: Ceuta is a geographic oddity, a colonial-era remnant that generates problems no other European border has.
segments.tr: Ada penafsiran yang nyaman yang tersedia: Ceuta adalah keunikan geografis, sisa era kolonial yang menimbulkan masalah yang tidak dimiliki oleh perbatasan Eropa lainnya.

segments.src: That reading is half right and dangerously incomplete.
segments.tr: Penafsiran itu setengah benar dan sangat tidak lengkap.

segments.src: What makes Ceuta instructive is not that it is unusual but that it is small enough to fail visibly and fast.
segments.tr: Apa yang membuat Ceuta instruktif bukanlah karena kota ini tidak biasa, tetapi karena kota ini cukup kecil untuk gagal secara kasat mata dan cepat.

segments.src: The same dependencies exist along the Libyan and Tunisian routes to Italy, the Turkish route to Greece, and the West African route to the Canaries.
segments.tr: Ketergantungan yang sama ada di sepanjang rute Libya dan Tunisia ke Italia, rute Turki ke Yunani, dan rute Afrika Barat ke Kepulauan Kanari.

segments.src: The difference is that those systems degrade over months, which allows them to be managed as a political process.
segments.tr: Perbedaannya adalah bahwa sistem-sistem tersebut memburuk selama berbulan-bulan, yang memungkinkan mereka dikelola sebagai proses politik.

segments.src: Ceuta degrades over hours, which does not.
segments.tr: Ceuta memburuk dalam hitungan jam, yang tidak memungkinkan hal itu.

segments.src: A policy framework that produces workable outcomes at the pace of a European Council meeting, and collapses at the pace of a weekend, has a specific and identifiable weakness.
segments.tr: Kerangka kebijakan yang menghasilkan hasil yang dapat dikerjakan secepat kecepatan rapat Dewan Eropa, dan runtuh secepat akhir pekan, memiliki kelemahan yang spesifik dan dapat diidentifikasi.

segments.src: Nine square miles just demonstrated it in public.
segments.tr: Sembilan mil persegi baru saja mendemonstrasikannya di depan umum.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang perlu diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: Three indicators will say more than any communiqué:
segments.tr: Tiga indikator akan menjelaskan lebih banyak daripada komunike mana pun:

segments.src: **How many people remain after thirty days.** The gap between arrival figures and residual figures is the single clearest measure of whether return mechanisms functioned.
segments.tr: **Berapa banyak orang yang tersisa setelah tiga puluh hari.** Kesenjangan antara angka kedatangan dan angka sisa adalah satu-satunya ukuran paling jelas tentang apakah mekanisme pengembalian berfungsi.
